query:
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.tokenBalance,
  DATE_FORMAT(u.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registeredAt,
  DATE_FORMAT(u.lastLoginAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastLogin,
  (SELECT ve.page FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastPage,
  (SELECT ve.eventType FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastEvent,
  (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ve.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastEventAt,
  (SELECT ua.actionType FROM user_actions ua WHERE ua.userId = u.id ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastAction,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_actions ua WHERE ua.userId = u.id) AS totalActions
FROM app_users u
WHERE u.tokenBalance = 10
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 30;
